low_doc_understand_file.notes: The request asks to understand the file. A general source summariser is acceptable, but extraction-only behavior is borderline.

low_doc_get_details.notes: The invoice context makes domain-specific extraction acceptable even though the controlled gold is the generic document field extractor.

low_doc_clean_up.notes: The instruction says not to change content, so rewriting is only borderline.

low_data_check_sheet.notes: The request is a broad overview. Reporting is acceptable, anomaly focus is only borderline without a specific anomaly cue.

low_data_something_off.notes: Something looks off cues anomaly detection. Overview is plausible but weaker.

low_code_check_change.notes: Before merge implies PR review. Generic code review is acceptable.

low_code_red_build.notes: A red build cues CI failure debugging, but generic root-cause debugging is acceptable.

low_news_catch_up.notes: Catch me up for an update is briefing-oriented; simple summarisation is acceptable.

low_meeting_next_steps.notes: Next things we need to do cues follow-up/action extraction. Summary is plausible but not the best fit.

low_reply_make_better.notes: Make this reply sound better cues polishing an existing reply.

low_security_login_risk.notes: Login setup risks cues auth-flow review; broader threat modeling is acceptable.

low_skill_existing_help.notes: Find whether a skill already exists cues skill finding. Evaluation is only borderline.
